established.statement: Ising {-1,+1} and MWC {0,1} local binary domains are related by x=(s+1)/2 and s=2x-1.
Both contain repeated local binary variables feeding a state score, exponential statistical weight, finite partition normalization, normalized probability, and weighted observables.

Ising field h and MWC ligand chemical-potential/control occupy the same lower algebraic role as external scalar biases on an aggregate local binary statistic, up to affine recoding, scale, and additive constants.
Ising uses direct nearest-neighbor local/local pair coupling on a cycle; frozen MWC uses one global binary conformation that modulates all local binding contributions.
Load-bearing interaction topology and global-conformation structure remain unmatched.
DP 0.7 found lower common structure without using domain labels and preserved the load-bearing residual instead of forcing a larger false match.
DP-21 did not manufacture a recurrence/fixed-point interpretation from repeated indexed sites.
